description: NaMn₃F₁₀ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fdd2 space group. Na is bonded to eight F atoms to form distorted NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra and edges with six MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 6°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.78 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MnF₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-33°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.06 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramid, corners with five MnF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-37°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.02 Å. There are five inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Mn atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Mn atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two Mn atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two Mn atoms.
